confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Helsinki pricing; no live listings were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence (about +/-15%); beer assumes a 0.5 l draft. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price because direct recall is weaker. Hostel and hotel July rates are least certain (about +/-25%) given summer demand swings. Values were set in EUR at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which is not verified for July 2026. The FX value is taken from the RBA exchange-rate table as reported in search results; the rba.gov.au page was not independently re-read, and the search summary flagged possible date-label inconsistencies.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single close comparable. Loosely benchmarked against Nordic capitals (Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen), with Helsinki placed toward the lower-cost end of that group for restaurants. Hotel and hostel levels reflect Helsinki's July tourist demand.
